note: Boards: design_handoff_admin_redesign/boards/02-needs-you/couldnt-load, 07-people-flags-operations/loading-any-list-on-mobile, loading-feature-flags; addendum-3 01-snooze/couldnt-load-m; bplus addendum-2 10-admin-couldnt-load. CONTACT_SHEET_ROLE=admin. Couldn't load is reached by routing the page's own API call to a 500 (the client then renders it); the error.tsx boundary has no trigger, so it is pinned by unit tests (page name from the route, no Error ID line). Loading skeletons are hand-walked: a route delay leaves the streamed loading.tsx up only briefly, so they are pinned by unit tests too. Venues fetches on the server (page.tsx apiClient), so a browser route cannot fail it: its kept h1 is pinned by VenuesList.test.
